issues.reason: Location is defined as "in/at/on …" and the mechanical rule on top of the oblique choice is that the head is the preposition actually used — never a synonym head for a near-fit reading — so the path PP "down the Cove Stair" takes the surface-preposition oblique (Down sk_walk_1 cove_stair), and folding it into Location swaps in a near-fit named role while dropping the stated direction.

gaps_confirmed: directional / path PP on a motion event has no named role (the list gives only Source "from", Goal "to", Location "in/at/on"), and the instruction set never states outright that such a PP takes the preposition-named oblique — the licence has to be read off the LocatedIn passage's "the same open licence as the event-side preposition-named oblique" sentence rather than from the oblique's own paragraph, which is written around aboutness PPs
defect_summary: Compliant form replaces (Location sk_walk_1 cove_stair) with the surface-preposition oblique (Down sk_walk_1 cove_stair); the rest of the parse stands unchanged.
